plugin.name: GPX Viewer
plugin.description: Explore GPX tracks, routes and waypoints on an interactive map with timeline playback, elevation and speed charts.
views.map.title: GPX Map
ui.privacy: GPX files stay on this device. The basemap service receives viewport tile coordinates.
ui.skippedCoordinates: Skipped {count} invalid coordinates; lines do not bridge the gaps.
ui.boundFile: Bind a GPX file to open this View.
ui.playbackUnavailable: Timestamps are incomplete. Drag the timeline to inspect points.
ui.timedHint: Playback follows recorded timestamps, retaining gaps between segments. Charts use point index; missing speeds are estimated between adjacent points.
ui.untimedHint: Timestamps are missing, repeated or out of order. Browse points by dragging; playback is unavailable. Charts use point index.
ui.retained: The last successfully loaded content is still displayed.
ui.mapFailure: The basemap failed to load. Tracks remain available. Reconnect and choose Retry basemap.
ui.webgl: The map requires WebGL. Check hardware acceleration in Eidos; statistics and the timeline remain available.
ui.fileTooLarge: This GPX exceeds 16 MiB. Split it before opening.
ui.entities: GPX files containing DTD or entity declarations are unsupported.
ui.invalidGpx: The file is not valid GPX 1.0 / 1.1 XML.
ui.tooManyPoints: The file exceeds 100,000 points. Split it before opening.
ui.noRoutes: The file contains no tracks, routes or waypoints to display.
ui.namespace: This file has no GPX namespace; compatibility parsing was used.
